A UNIVERSAL QC STABILIZER AT COEFFICIENT 4096
31 October 2026. Exact algebra and a completed rigorous real-ball cover.

THEOREM

For the fixed non-aligned Hopf quartic F and the normalized cubic

 C0(a,b,c,d)=c^2(N1 b-N2 c-N3 d)/(N1+N2+N3),
 N1=31217529334374656693061585,
 N2=11227847587653454406233358,
 N3=11325834422047516078245,

the polynomial

                    p=F+C0+4096|A|^2                 (1)

is globally quasiconvex. This holds for EVERY mean matrix and EVERY
actual periodic L4 gradient perturbation, not a finite field family.
The same statement holds with C0 replaced by lambda C0 and the
quadratic coefficient by 4096 lambda^2, for every real lambda.

The retained globally ROC example F+C0+1859|A|^2 still has UNKNOWN
QC status. No ROC/QC separation, classification of the full exposed
face, optimal stabilizer, or external independent audit is asserted.

Literal data are certificate.json. The independently reconstructing
receiver and its completed output are receive.py and replay.json.
The coefficient 4096 is a proved sufficient coefficient. The earlier
2048 numerical correction had an exact negative Schur witness and
was rejected. Its failure is retained in work/ and is not a QC
counterexample. A later fit was only used to propose the data below.

1. THE GLOBAL HEAT GRAM

Let h=(u_xx,u_xy,u_yy,v_xx,v_xy,v_yy),
 B1=(h0,h1,h3,h4), B2=(h1,h2,h4,h5). Certificate data define:

 alpha_L=sum_i P_i(A)/|A|^2 dA_i, each P_i homogeneous degree five;
 Omega_C, a closed two-form whose coefficients are linear in A;
 Omega_Q, a constant two-form;
 X(A), a 6 by 6 matrix linear in A;
 D_Q=2*4096 diag(1,2,1,1,2,1)+matrix[Omega_Q(B1,B2)].

Use S_L(A) for the symmetric matrix of

   F''(A)[B1,B1]+F''(A)[B2,B2]+(d alpha_L)_A(B1,B2).

The receiver reconstructs every polynomial from the literal data.
It verifies D_Q>0 exactly, closure d Omega_C=0, and the identity

 h^T (X(A)+X(A)^T) h
   =C0''(A)[B1,B1]+C0''(A)[B2,B2]+(Omega_C)_A(B1,B2).  (2)

Thus the corrected heat density for (1) is

 h^T S_L(A)h+2h^T X(A)h+h^T D_Q h.

It suffices to prove the following matrix inequality for EVERY A:

               [ S_L(A)   X(A) ]
               [ X(A)^T    D_Q ] >=0.               (3)

Indeed, evaluate its quadratic form on (h,h). This sufficient Gram
condition is not asserted to be necessary for QC.
